scene_description: Two children are playing on a sandy beach. One child is pouring water from a red bucket onto a large sandcastle decorated with colorful triangle flags. The ocean and blue sky are visible in the background.

questions.question: What are the children building in the sand?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big sandy structure in front of the children.

questions.question: What is the child with the red bucket doing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the red bucket and what is coming out of it.

questions.question: Where are the two children playing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the ground under their feet and the water behind them.

questions.question: What are the little flags on the sandcastle for?
sample_answers: to put on top of the castle
questions.evidence_hint: Look at where the flags are placed on the sandcastle.

questions.question: What might happen to the sandcastle after the water is poured on it?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the water coming out of the bucket and where it is landing.

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever played in the sand or at the beach?
optional_extension_questions.sentence_frame: I went to the beach and ___.
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you played outside in the sand or water.
